scripts.repo:check: node scripts/check/verify-runtime.mjs && node scripts/check/verify-repository.mjs && node scripts/check/check-boundaries.mjs && node --test scripts/check/*.test.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/check/verify-repository.mjs contracts && node scripts/contracts/generate.mjs --check && turbo run contracts:check
scripts.compose:dev:up: docker compose -p ai-crm-dev -f deploy/compose/compose.base.yml -f deploy/compose/compose.dev.yml up -d --wait
scripts.compose:dev:down: docker compose -p ai-crm-dev -f deploy/compose/compose.base.yml -f deploy/compose/compose.dev.yml down
scripts.check: pnpm repo:check && pnpm compose:check && node scripts/contracts/generate.mjs --check && turbo run build lint typecheck test contracts:check
